title: TanStack Query Layer Plan
description: A structured plan for a TanStack Query v5 server-state layer, so this skill's anti-patterns and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/tanstack_query_audit.mjs.

stateKind.description: What the cache would hold. TanStack Query is only for server state; client-state is a critical mismatch.

queryKeySource.description: Where query keys come from: a typed factory in one file, or inline array/string literals scattered across the codebase.

staleTimeExplicit.description: True if each query family sets staleTime deliberately instead of inheriting the v5 default of 0.

hasMutations.description: True if the layer includes useMutation flows (POST/PUT/DELETE).

invalidationScope.description: How mutations invalidate the cache: by factory prefix, by exact key only, or not at all.

optimisticUpdates.description: True if any mutation performs an optimistic cache write.

cancelsInFlightQueriesFirst.description: For optimistic updates: true if onMutate awaits cancelQueries before writing, so an in-flight GET cannot overwrite the optimistic value.

snapshotsForRollback.description: For optimistic updates: true if onMutate snapshots the current cache and returns it as context for the onError rollback.

settledInvalidation.description: For optimistic updates: true if onSettled (not onSuccess) invalidates the affected prefix so server truth wins after success and failure alike.

ssr.description: True if the app server-renders (Next.js App Router or similar) with query prefetch/hydration.

queryClientPerRequest.description: For SSR: true if a fresh QueryClient is created per server request (never a module-level singleton shared across users).

realtimeViaPollingIntervalMs.description: If refetchInterval polling is used to simulate real-time, the interval in ms. Omit if not polling.
